Created the Node ESM port in `/output` with only local `.mjs` imports and no npm dependencies.

Files:
- Base58 modules: [alphabet.mjs](/output/lib/base58/alphabet.mjs), [core.mjs](/output/lib/base58/core.mjs), [check.mjs](/output/lib/base58/check.mjs), [errors.mjs](/output/lib/base58/errors.mjs), [index.mjs](/output/lib/base58/index.mjs)

- Entry file: [test20.mjs](/output/test20.mjs)

The implementation manually parses `process.argv`, reproduces Python-style `print(bytes_obj)` formatting, and reimplements Base58, Base58Check, and integer encode/decode in pure JavaScript. I verified it against `/workspace/dataset/test20_executable` on all 4 provided sample cases, the CLI help/error cases, several byte-format edge cases, and 20 randomized valid comparisons; the outputs matched.
